review_candidates.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description The Senior Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for designing, delivering, supporting and maintaining secure, resilient and supportable infrastructure solutions across AJ Bell’s technology estate. The role acts as a senior technical contributor within the Infrastructure team. It owns technical design and delivery for medium-sized infrastructure changes and projects, understands dependencies between systems and workstreams, guides Infrastructure Engineers, and ensures work is delivered in line with agreed standards, controls and security expectations. The Senior Infrastructure Engineer is expected to be highly technically skilled and experienced across multiple infrastructure technologies. The role balances hands-on delivery with planning, technical leadership, stakeholder communication, operational support, documentation, risk awareness and security-focused best practice. The role supports the reliability, security, scalability and maintainability of AJ Bell’s infrastructure services, while supporting and enabling the business to achieve its regulatory requirements, including Consumer Duty. Competence and Knowledge Competence Strong experience in an Infrastructure Engineer or similar technical role, preferably gained in a Financial Services, regulated or business-critical technology environment. Experience designing, delivering and supporting production infrastructure services. Ability to own technical design and delivery for medium-sized infrastructure changes or projects. Strong understanding of dependencies between infrastructure technologies, applications, networks, identity, security and operational processes. Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and support timely incident and problem resolution. Experience producing technical documentation, implementation plans, support handover material and standards documentation. Experience working within change control, operational governance and service management processes. Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks, decisions and trade-offs clearly. Ability to coach, guide and support less experienced engineers. Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver work to agreed timescales. Strong understanding of security, resilience, monitoring, capacity and maintainability considerations. Experience working with suppliers and third-party support providers where required. Knowledge VMware technologies including Dell VxRail hyperconverged infrastructure, Aria Suite, NSX, HCX, vSAN, VCF and VMC. Load balancing technologies such as VMware AVI, NSX or equivalent. Fortinet SD-WAN and firewall technologies, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer and FortiClient VPN or equivalent. Microsoft Windows Server and Red Hat Enterprise Linux server configuration and management. Monitoring and observability tooling such as SolarWinds, Opsgenie, Grafana, Prometheus or equivalent. Storage, backup and disaster recovery technologies, including SAN/NAS, replication, snapshotting and recovery testing concepts. Identity and access technologies such as Active Directory, ADFS, SSO and MFA. Cisco networking technologies, Cisco ISE and Catalyst Centre or equivalent demonstrable networking experience. Infrastructure performance and capacity monitoring, planning and remediation. AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, container platform concepts and cloud-based infrastructure patterns desirable. Infrastructure as Code, automation, scripting and CI/CD practices desirable with experience of Terraform preferred Security tooling and practices including patch management, vulnerability management, SIEM, EDR, PAM and micro-segmentation desirable. ITIL service management and PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum or equivalent project delivery experience beneficial. Personal And Other Skills Able to manage complexity and ambiguity, seeking the information and perspectives required to make effective decisions. Demonstrates good judgement, ownership and self-awareness when balancing business need, risk, security and operational impact. Focuses on customers by protecting service reliability, supporting agreed service levels and improving customer experience. Understands the link between Infrastructure, wider Technology Services teams and business outcomes. Engages others effectively through clear communication, constructive challenge, useful feedback and knowledge sharing. Makes good decisions by considering evidence, technical options, wider consequences and long-term maintainability. Works as part of a team to drive improvements, reduce operational risk and support long-term changes Builds and maintains strong working relationships across the Technology Services department and wider business. About AJ Bell At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. Whether you're looking for an ISA, pension or dealing account, whether you want to invest with the help of a financial adviser or do it yourself, we have easy-to-use solutions to suit people from all walks of life. We're one of the UK's fastest-growing investment platform businesses, trusted by everyone from professional financial advisers to first-time investors. Today, over 762,000 customers trust us to manage more than £121.5 billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we're helping more people take control of their financial futures. We're proud to be recognised as one of the UK's Best 100 Companies to Work For for six consecutive years, and a Great Place to Work® in 2025 and 2026, a reflection of our supportive and collaborative culture. What We Offer Competitive starting salary 26 days holiday, increasing with service + buy/sell scheme + bank holidays 7% Pension with matched contributions Discretionary bonus scheme Share schemes (including free shares and BAYE) Health Cash Plan and discounted private healthcare Free gym Enhanced family leave (subject to qualifying criteria) Travel and bike loan schemes Employee Assistance Programme Life at AJ Bell Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties Learning and development opportunities tailored to you Casual dress code Friendly, supportive team environment Our ways of working At AJ Bell, our people are the heart of our culture. We believe in building strong connections by working together. That's why we offer a hybrid working model, where you'll spend a minimum of 50% of working time per month in the office. For new team members, an initial period will be spent full-time in the office to help you immerse yourself in our business and build valuable relationships with your colleagues. Inclusion & diversity We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected, supported and able to be themselves at work. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential. Agency information This vacancy is being managed exclusively by our in-house Recruitment team. We are not partnering with recruitment agencies on this opportunity and will only accept applications submitted directly by candidates

Your Responsibilities: Design, implement and maintain server, storage, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure. Administer Windows Server, Linux and Microsoft Azure services, including identity and access-management components. Manage VMware vSphere, ESXi and vCenter environments. Identify and deliver infrastructure automation, resilience and service-improvement opportunities Requirements Essential Skills, Qualifications & Experience: Experience administering Microsoft infrastructure, including Windows Server and Azure resources Deploying and managing virtualised environments using VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter Knowledge of server and storage hardware technologies Strong understanding of core networking services, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, firewalls and VPN connectivity Proven experience supporting enterprise IT infrastructure, including servers, storage, networking and cloud services Experience with backup, disaster recovery, patching and infrastructure lifecycle management Experience with enterprise storage, SAN/NAS and backup solutions Experience using scripting and automation tools, such as PowerShell, Bash or Python Knowledge of infrastructure monitoring, alerting and incident resolution Strong troubleshooting, documentation and communication skills Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience: Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS or other public-cloud platforms Experience using Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools Knowledge of Git and CI/CD pipelines Knowledge of cyber security controls, vulnerability remediation and privileged access management Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or container platforms Experience supporting hybrid-cloud environments and cloud migration projects Relevant technical certifications, such as Microsoft, VMware, Cisco or Oracle Cloud Benefits We offer the following benefits: Salary dependent on experience + travel allowance + bonus Enhanced holiday. Income Protection Private Medical Insurance as standard for you, your partner and any dependents. Including hospital Cash Plan Employee discounts Electric car scheme Nursery Salary Sacrifice scheme Cycle to Work Scheme Family Planning Neurodiversity support including advise and assessments Coaching & Therapy services Working Together - What It Involves: You must have the right to work permanently in the UK with a willingness to travel as necessary. You will live in, or within easy commuting distance of, Oxford (or be willing to relocate) During peak periods, some longer hours may be required and some working across multiple time zones due to the global nature of the programme.

Crediamo fortemente nelle persone: per questo offriamo percorsi di certificazioni specialistiche e un piano formativo continuo e strutturato, pensato per sviluppare competenze reali e creare valore nel tempo. Siamo alla ricerca di un Network Engineer da inserire in un importante progetto in ambito Enterprise Infrastructure, dedicato alla progettazione, implementazione, gestione e ottimizzazione di infrastrutture di rete complesse. Attività: Progettazione, configurazione e manutenzione di reti LAN, WAN e WLAN distribuite su più sedi. Gestione e troubleshooting di router, switch, firewall, SD-WAN e VPN. Monitoraggio delle prestazioni della rete e implementazione di interventi di ottimizzazione. Configurazione e gestione delle misure di sicurezza di rete (firewall, controlli di accesso e crittografia). Pianificazione della capacità della rete e aggiornamento della documentazione tecnica. Collaborazione con i team di System Administration e Cybersecurity per garantire continuità operativa e conformità. Gestione e risoluzione degli incidenti di rete. Requisiti: Dai 4-5 anni di esperienza nel ruolo di Network Engineer o posizione equivalente. Necessaria ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata. Solida esperienza con protocolli di routing e switching (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLAN). Esperienza nella gestione di infrastrutture Cisco. Esperienza nel troubleshooting di problematiche di connettività, performance e sicurezza. Buona conoscenza di VPN, IPSec, MPLS e SD-WAN. Costituiscono un plus: Certificazioni CCNA, CCNP o equivalenti. Esperienza su ambienti Cloud (Azure, AWS o GCP). Certificazione ITIL Foundation e Laurea in ambito informatico. Cosa offriamo: RAL indicativa: €40.000 - €45.000, commisurata all'autonomia sulle competenze richieste. Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e orientato all'innovazione. Opportunità di crescita professionale e aggiornamento continuo. Modalità: da remoto.

review_candidates.title: Cloud Engineer - Linux and Automation
review_candidates.description: Position Overview The Cloud, Engineer - Linux and Automation is responsible for the administration, automation, and continuous improvement of Thrive's Linux-based infrastructure. This role serves as an escalation point for Tier 1 issues and works closely with senior engineers and architects to design and implement repeatable, code-driven infrastructure solutions. The engineer will maintain and develop automation frameworks using Ansible and Terraform, assist with managing Thrive's private cloud on HPE Morpheus Enterprise and VMware ecosystems, and ensure Ubuntu-based systems are secure, patched, and operating within established SLAs. The ideal candidate brings hands-on IaC experience, strong Linux troubleshooting skills, and a mindset oriented toward automation and operational excellence - all with a security first focus required to avoid unexpected downtime. Responsibilities Administer, monitor, and troubleshoot Linux systems (primarily Ubuntu) across physical and virtual environments. Serve as a Tier 2 escalation point for infrastructure incidents; perform root cause analysis and implement remediation actions. Manage and operate virtual machine workloads within HPE Morpheus Enterprise HVM and VMware ESXi, including VM provisioning, lifecycle management, and hypervisor-level troubleshooting. Define and enforce standardized build documentation Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks for configuration management, OS patching, application deployment, and compliance enforcement. Write and manage Terraform configurations for infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management. Enforce infrastructure-as-code best practices including version control and peer review. Maintain and update NetBox as the authoritative source of truth for IP address management (IPAM), DCIM asset records, and network topology documentation. Integrate Netbox with IaC tools for automation of routine physical equipment commissioning Participate in change management processes, ensuring all changes are documented, reviewed, and approved in alignment with Thrive's ITSM standards. Perform routine system health checks, capacity reviews, and performance tuning for Linux servers. Maintain and improve internal runbooks, technical documentation, and knowledge base articles. Collaborate with networking, security, and cloud teams to resolve cross-functional infrastructure issues. Participate in an on-call rotation to support critical infrastructure incidents outside of standard business hours. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation and standardization. Requirements 3-5+ years of hands-on Linux system administration experience with strong proficiency in Ubuntu Linux including systems, networking, storage management, and security hardening 2+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, specifically Ansible (roles, playbooks, inventories) and Terraform (state management, CI/CD plan/apply workflows) Hands-on familiarity with HPE Morpheus Enterprise or similar HVM/KVM platforms for VM provisioning, template management, and self-service automation; experience with VMware vCenter is a strong plus Working knowledge of NetBox for IPAM, DCIM, and network source-of-truth management; experience with NetBox API integrations preferred Proficiency in scripting languages for automation and tooling development Solid understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, and firewall rules as they apply to virtualized and cloud environments Familiarity with Git-based version control and collaborative workflows (GitLab or GitHub) Ability to diagnose and resolve complex system and infrastructure issues independently and under pressure Strong documentation habits - able to produce accurate and maintainable runbooks, topology diagrams, and change records Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a diverse workload Strong team player - collaborates effectively with peers and cross-functional teams to solve problems Proactive, change-oriented mindset - actively seeks process improvements and drives automation-first approaches Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related discipline — or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience Knowledge of ITIL and ITSM best practices Preferred Certifications: Linux Professional Institute Certification (LPIC-1/LPIC-2) or Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA); Red Hat Enterprise Linux Automation with Ansible (RH294) or better; HashiCorp Terraform Associate (003 or 004); Other: Work Schedule: Standard business hours with participation in an on-call rotation. Remote work eligible Travel Requirements: Occasional travel may be required for datacenter activities. Less than 10% Applicant selected will be subject to a criminal and credit background investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to restricted information. Candidate must be able to pass CJIS clearance for the state of Florida.

review_candidates.description: Senior Infrastructure Engineer Reports to: Head of Platform Engineering Location: Manchester — 5 days on site Salary: £45,000–55,000 About the Company UniqueX delivers innovative, autonomous software solutions and content services to cinemas worldwide. With operations in over 90 countries, our systems power everything from blockbuster film delivery to Theatre Management System (TMS) installations for some of the world's largest cinema chains and studios. We're a growing team with global reach, based out of offices in Manchester, Norway, and Lithuania. Join us to help shape the future of cinema automation. Team and Job Purpose As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you will own the infrastructure that delivers cinema content worldwide — a global estate of physical and virtualised servers across data centres in Europe, North America and Africa, alongside our cloud footprint. This includes setting the standards for how the estate is monitored, automated and recovered, and leading the engineering work that strengthens it as it grows. Content has to reach cinemas before showtime, so reliability in this role is business-critical. This is a full-time role based in Manchester, with sites outside the UK managed remotely. Key Responsibilities Infrastructure & Storage • Maintain high-availability storage across the estate. • Plan capacity and hardware lifecycle, coordinating replacements with colo providers and remote hands teams. • Hold access to the Manchester data centres and support physical operations on site. Platform Improvement & Delivery • Strengthen resilience across the estate as it scales, designing out risk in advance. • Support and extend our Central Storage platform, including its object storage, service layer, ingest stations and index services. • Deliver new infrastructure capability, including new sites, services and tooling that improve operability. Monitoring & Alerting • Design monitoring that provides early warning on hardware, storage and content delivery. • Improve alerting quality and escalation logic so that attention is directed where it is needed. • Lead incident response and post-incident review, ensuring findings are fed back into the platform. Infrastructure Automation & Tooling • Maintain and grow the code that manages the estate, so servers and cloud resources are defined in code rather than configured by hand. • Apply AI-assisted tooling to investigation, automation and documentation, verifying output before it reaches production. Team & Project Contributions • Mentor engineers through review and pairing. • Ensure clear documentation and handover for all platform components and access paths. Who We're Looking For This role suits an experienced infrastructure engineer with deep Linux systems knowledge and confidence owning physical and virtualised server environments across multiple sites. You'll coordinate directly with colo providers and remote hands teams in several countries, and be comfortable making decisions without close oversight — including acting as the senior technical point of escalation for infrastructure incidents. Essential Skills • Extensive Linux systems engineering experience at senior level (Ubuntu or similar) • In-depth storage knowledge and how it fails — software RAID, Ceph, NFS • Ansible and Terraform in production • Docker and containerised services • Confident in at least one programming language — Java, Python or similar — alongside shell scripting • Willingness to participate in an on-call rota — shared, with a paid standby allowance • Sound judgement under incident pressure, with strong written documentation and communication skills Desirable Skills • Proxmox or comparable virtualisation • Working knowledge of AWS • Monitoring and inventory tooling such as PRTG and NetBox • Networking: firewalls, site-to-site VPN, routing • Previous experience in media or content distribution Working Arrangements • On site: the role holds data centre access and supports physical operations, so this is five days a week in Manchester rather than hybrid • On-call: shared rota with a paid standby allowance • Right to work: UK right to work required; we are not able to sponsor visas

review_candidates.description: This position is available only under an employment (labor) agreement. The world’s digital experiences run on something invisible: the infrastructure and software that keep them fast, reliable, and secure. At Gcore, you’ll help design and deliver that foundation for an AI-driven world. We’re a global provider of infrastructure and software solutions for AI, cloud, network, and security, powering everything from real-time communication and streaming to enterprise AI and secure web applications. You’ll collaborate with leading technology partners such as Intel, NVIDIA, Dell, and Equinix, and work on platforms that power digital products used around the world. Our vision is simple: to connect the world to AI, anywhere, anytime. Want to work on technology that goes beyond a single product or industry? Join a global team of 550+ professionals building infrastructure and software that supports the entire digital ecosystem. Gcore WAAP protects customer web applications and APIs against DDoS, bots, and application-layer attacks at CDN edge scale. We are building out a proactive, managed-support offering for enterprise customers, and we need a SOC Analyst to run the day-to-day security operations: watch traffic and alerts, triage false positives, prepare customer-facing threat reports, and escalate real impact to the right team. You will work alongside our Threat Researchers, taking the operational load off them so they can focus on deep analysis. You do not need to be a threat-hunting expert. You need to be reliable, observant, comfortable in logs and dashboards, and able to tell an attack from legitimate traffic - and know when to escalate. What You Will Do Monitor WAAP and DDoS activity across customer accounts - dashboards, alerts, and traffic patterns - and recognize when something needs attention. Triage false positives: review traffic flagged by security policies, confirm or dismiss, and keep noise down for customers (this is a large, daily part of the job). Prepare reports: weekly threat summaries per customer and post-incident DDoS reports, in clear customer-facing English. Alert and escalate: when an attack is impacting a customer, signal the engineering team or Support with the right context - e.g. a customer needs to be tagged or a policy adjusted - and follow the escalation runbook. Support customer onboarding: apply standard security configuration based on the customer's profile (resource type, traffic volume, legitimate-traffic exclusions) following playbooks. Follow the reaction-time SLA - our commitment to customers is speed of reaction and clear post-incident reporting, not a prevention guarantee. Contribute to and maintain runbooks so responses are consistent and repeatable. What We are Looking For Understanding of web security fundamentals: WAF, DDoS, bots, OWASP Top 10. Solid basics in HTTP, TCP/IP, TLS. Comfortable analyzing logs and reading dashboards; can spot anomalies in traffic. Able to distinguish malicious from legitimate traffic and reason about false positives. Clear written English for customer-facing reports. Reliable, detail-oriented, and calm under incident pressure. Willingness to work in a shift/on-call rotation. Nice to Have Prior SOC L1/L2 or related experience. Basic query/scripting: SQL-like log queries, regex, a bit of Python. Familiarity with CDN/WAF platforms (Cloudflare, Akamai, Imperva, F5, Radware). Exposure to SIEM / alerting tooling and PagerDuty-style on-call. Security certifications (e.g. CompTIA Security+) - a plus, not a requirement. Explicitly NOT Required Deep threat research, exploit development, malware reverse-engineering. That work stays with our Threat Researchers - this role feeds them clean, triaged signal and takes the routine off their plate. Why This Role Matters You become the first line of Gcore WAAP's managed security operations - the person who keeps customers informed and protected day to day, and who lets our specialists focus on the hard problems. High visibility, direct customer impact, and a clear path to grow into threat research or detection engineering. Benefits At Gcore, we want you to do your best work and enjoy the journey. review_candidates.title: Senior TechOps Generalist
review_candidates.description: Seen this advert before? That is because we are continuing to grow! We are very excited to be growing our small and efficient TechOps team at Octopus. We aren't looking for standard IT support - we are looking for an ambitious, deeply knowledgeable and experienced TechOps Generalist to join our team, to grow with the rest of the company, and ensure we are doing so in a secure and safe way. You will be a key partner in defining what TechOps is at Octopus. We will be continuing to shape this team to provide world class support to our employees, building our way out of problems with engineering firepower and undertaking transformational organisational change. We don't just "fix" things - we automate them out of existence. For us, a Generalist isn’t about knowing a little of everything, it’s a multi-disciplinary role for someone who’s deeply experienced in many facets of Enterprise IT. Think multi-domain specialist - not Jack of all trades. What is TechOps? A more modern, more lean version of a traditional Enterprise IT team with around one of us for every 1000 people at Octopus. We cover everything from what most people would call “1st line support” all the way up to high-level strategic planning, and everything in between. We tackle big problems and the breadth of work is huge. Dealing with ambiguity is a key part of working in TechOps, and every day will be a new and exciting one, working on varying challenges across the company and keeping plates spinning. We have a cloud-first approach to everything we do. This allows us to scale quickly and focus on things where we can add the most value. No on-prem AD here! Roles that you might currently be in: Systems engineer, DevOps, Tech support, Technical support, Technical support analyst, IT support, IT desktop support, Systems Administrator, Network Administrator, Workplace technology, Solutions specialist, Solutions administrator, Systems manager, Support manager. What you'll do Provide delightful day-to-day technical support to all areas of the business, to ensure our incredible employees are able to do their job as efficiently as possible. Their problems are our problems Troubleshoot and fix a wide range of technical issues, from laptop faults and network issues, to account provisioning failures and SSO problems Collaborate closely with our Security team to ensure we strike the right balance between security, productivity and user experience Continually find opportunities to automate our processes and improve the user experience Empower our people to help themselves by designing and building self-service solutions Monitor and maintain all the tech in our offices around the world - networks, meeting rooms, printers, digital signage, CCTV, door access control Managing supplier relationships and the procurement process for SaaS and hardware Lead and manage complex technical projects with multiple stakeholders from around the business. Examples of some TechOps projects include… Rollout of, and migration to, a new identity provider macOS and Windows MDM migration Rollout of a new device trust and posture compliance solution The replacement of insecure factors like SMS with phishing-resistant factors Office fit-outs, including tech like network, AV, access control etc SaaS migrations for acquisitions e.g. Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace What you'll need We’re looking for people with at least 5-7 years of solid enterprise IT experience. The technical bar is high. While we use Okta, Kandji, Kolide, Zscaler, Meraki and HiBob amongst others, we care about your understanding of the fundamentals of key SaaS tooling, but we also expect candidates to have significant experience implementing and customising these tools for Enterprise environments, so if you’ve lived in Entra and Intune? Awesome! You’ll also need: Confidence in articulating and implementing your technical ability, particularly with enterprise-level SaaS tooling, customer support and automation. The ability to do this both with your peers and novice users is vital A team player - we don’t want people who vanish and come back with perfect, completed work. You collaborate and work transparently and can identify who can help you, or needs your help Rich experience and examples of scripting, using APIs to automating mundane and error-prone repetitive tasks To be comfortable with a huge amount of ambiguity and spinning a lot of plates all at the same time Experience working with multiple teams and managing multiple stakeholders Experience managing and deploying macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android at scale Experience administering and troubleshooting Single Sign-On (SSO) technologies such as OAuth, OIDC and SAML Deep experience with Identity & Access Management. You should be able to explain the nuances of SAML, OIDC, and OAuth , and have hands-on experience with SCIM provisioning Experience of designing and installing office networks - we use Cisco Meraki A conscientious approach to everything you do and a passion for doing the right thing rather than the easy thing Don’t think you check off every single box? We love hiring passionate people with a drive to learn. If you are an expert in some of these areas and are hungry to master the rest, get in touch and let us know where your strengths lie. Why else you'll love it here Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture . An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We won best company to work for in 2022, on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022 and our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership Visit our UK perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits This role can be either fully office based in any of our major offices in Brighton, Manchester, Leicester, Coventry or London , or a hybrid of a few days a week working remotely and office based. Our salary bandings are between £65,000 - £90,000 depending on your experience. On a call with one of our talent team, it's something we always chat through, as we genuinely want to match your experience with the right salary. We're very excited to be growing our small team. We're looking for skills and experience to help shape and define the future of not only our team, but the wider business at a global scale. If you're reading this and grinning, please apply! There are huge challenges to tackle, and we need amazing people who are keen to get stuck in. If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you. Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic! Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone. Where necessary, we sometimes use AI tools to help with parts of our hiring process, like reviewing applications or assessing responses. We’re lucky to receive a huge amount of interest, so these tools help our recruiters manage that volume, not replace them. Ultimately, every hiring decision (for example, whether to progress your application or not) is always made by a real person in our Talent team. If you’d like to know more about how we use your data, you can reach out to us via email at talent@octoenergy.com. We’re happy to help!

review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: Location/s: Tadley, Bristol, London, Glasgow, Altrincham; UK Recruiter contact: Cassidy Browne Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy with over 20,000 employees across more than 50 countries and 140+ offices. We work across incredible global industries, delivering exciting work that is defining our future and making an important societal impact in the communities we serve. Our people power our performance – we succeed when they do. With countless opportunities to collaborate, learn, and grow, the possibilities for excellence are as varied as every individual. Whether you want to grow as a subject matter expert or broaden your experience with roles across our international community, you’re surrounded by global specialists who want to combine their expertise and champion you to be your best. As a proudly employee-owned business, we benefit our clients, our communities, and each other, investing in creating the right space for everyone to feel empowered, included, and valued. Whatever your ambition, Mott MacDonald is where people come to be brilliant. About The business unit The Energy unit delivers services to clients globally across several sectors including hydropower, nuclear, waste, renewable generation and transmission & distribution networks. Together we provide integrated engineering and project management services across the project lifecycle – from concept and design to construction and operations, to decommissioning or repowering and life extension. Together with our clients, we’re helping to deliver the energy transition globally. Overview Of The Role Our Nuclear; Defence and Civil division is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer. This role involves working closely with clients, designers, other systems engineers. You will lead stakeholder workshops, develop system architectures, and will be expected to meet deadlines set for key systems engineering deliverables, including: Project Systems Engineering Management Plan (SEMP) Requirements and Acceptance Management Strategy (RAMS) & Plan (RAMP) Interface Management Plan System Requirements Specification System Architecture Description System/ Subsystem Design Descriptions Interface Control Documents System Integration Management Plan Our team provides a range of key services, including: Requirements Management System Architecture Development and Modelling Technical Interface Management and System Integration Design Assurance, Verification, and Validation Management Configuration Management Key responsibilities and duties include: Influence, capture and translate stakeholder vision and define the scope and boundary of the system, along with its Concept of Operations Propose, develop and manage system requirements throughout the system lifecycle, using an appropriate requirements management tool Develop all required system architectural views (functional and physical), including, but not limited to Functional, System and Spatial Breakdown Structures Apply appropriate scenario modelling and role modelling techniques to contribute to capability assurance evidence Work with designers to define internal and external system technical interfaces Identification and management of technical assumptions, dependencies and constraints Develop and review systems engineering artefacts, as necessary, to support technical reviews and client deliverables Generate and manage objective Verification & Validation evidence Support configuration management of the system design baseline and contribute to impact assessments and management of technical change Organise and lead stakeholder workshops, defining metrics and acceptance criteria Communicate complex technical content clearly to stakeholders at all levels and collaborate effectively across multi-disciplinary engineering teams Produce high quality technical reports, presentations and project artefacts as required by company processes and project delivery Support and mentor junior staff, overseeing task supervision and professional development Candidate specification Essential: Strong understanding of systems engineering techniques applied across the entire engineering lifecycle, with demonstrable experience in a significant portion of the lifecycle Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly Strong background in requirements development, preferably for infrastructure projects Knowledge and experience in applying a Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) approach, including system architecture development against an Architectural Framework Knowledge of System Integration, Test, Evaluation and Acceptance strategies Proficiency in use of typical systems engineering toolsets, e.g. for requirement management (DOORS, or similar) and architecture definition (Sparx EA, or similar) Excellent written communication skills with a methodical, detail-focused approach Preferably experience in infrastructure projects and ideally the nuclear sector. However, experience in developing complex systems in any highly regulated, multi-disciplinary engineering industry is valued Degree level qualification, or equivalent, in a technical discipline Preferably professionally registered as an engineer, or willing to work towards Due to the sensitivity of some of our projects, candidates will be required to apply for and obtain UK Security Clearance. UK Immigration Mott MacDonald Ltd. are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024. We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future. Agile working At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well-being, flexibility, and trust. Equality, diversity, and inclusion We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels they can contribute. AI Usage At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application. Accessibility We want you to perform your best at every stage in the recruitment process. If you are disabled or need any support to enable you to apply or attend an interview, please contact us at reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com and we will talk to you about how we can support you. We offer some fantastic benefits including: Financial wellbeing We match employee pension contributions between 4.5% and 7%. Life assurance equal up to 4 x your basic salary, with an option to increase the level of cover to 6 x your salary. Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long-term illness or injury. Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing. As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues in various ways including annual bonus schemes. Employee Ownership Our employee ownership model means no external investors, just us, creating a culture of shared success. Our employees have a stake and a voice in our business, giving them a direct connection to our success through our personal and group performance bonuses. As your career grows, so does your stake, recognising your long-term impact and contribution. Your voice matters, with the opportunity to connect directly with senior leadership through formal channels to help shape our future. For our senior roles you will have a direct pathway towards ownership from day one. Health and wellbeing Private medical insurance for all UK colleagues. Health cash plan to support you with every day health costs and treatments. Access to Peppy, providing free support from menopause experts for all UK colleagues. A variety of wellbeing support is available through our comprehensive wellbeing program, including access for you and your family. Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too. Lifestyle A minimum of 33-35 days holiday each year, inclusive of public holidays and dependent on level, with the ability to buy or sell leave through our flexible benefits programme. 10 days additional paid leave for Armed Forces Reservists and Cadet Force Adult Volunteers. Holiday entitlement increased to a minimum of 35 days after 5 years’ service. Variety of employee saving schemes and discounts from high-street retailers. Enhanced family and carers leave Enhanced family leave policies, including 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave, and two weeks paid paternity/partner leave. Our shared parental leave matches maternity leave meaning we pay up to 24 weeks at full pay. Up to five additional days leave are provided for those with significant caring responsibilities, two of which are paid. We offer policies and dedicated support to help military families balance service life with career and wellbeing. Learning and development Primary annual professional institution subscription. A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self-development options. Networks, communities, and social outcomes Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities. We are proud signatories of the Armed Forces Covenant and Gold Award holders in the MOD Employer Recognition Scheme, supported by our dedicated internal Armed Forces Network. Make a difference within our communities through our social outcomes. Apply now, or for more information about our application process, click here. Location(s): Tadley, GB Bristol, GB Altrincham, GB Glasgow, GB London, GB Contract Type: Permanent Work Pattern: Full Time Market: Energy Discipline: Systems and signals Job Ref: 16110 Recruiter Contact: Cassidy Browne

review_candidates.title: Platform Operations Engineer
review_candidates.description: Join Us At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact. Global Cyber Security’s role is to inspire trust and confidence in our customers by enabling secure connectivity. Our purpose is to proactively protect Vodafone & its customers by reducing the risks posed by security threats to Vodafone’s global technology infrastructure and the sensitive data it holds. As the CNAPP Platform Operations lead/practitioner, you will own the day-to-day operation, stability and continuous improvement of Vodafone’s Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP). You will ensure robust RBAC and identity governance, reliable integration across cloud environments and CI/CD toolchains, that findings are triaged and routed effectively, and that policies and controls are implemented in a pragmatic way that reduces risk without blocking delivery. You will collaborate closely with Cloud Security, Engineering, DevSecOps, SOC and Product teams to embed CNAPP into ways of working and to drive measurable improvements in cloud security posture. What You’ll Do Own CNAPP run operations: monitoring, health checks, incident management, vendor escalation and release/change planning; Manage CNAPP as a service: define support model (L2/L3), operational processes, service backlog and continuous improvement cadence; Maintain platform configuration, guardrails and standards across the cloud estate; Design and operate CNAPP RBAC aligned to Vodafone’s security model, ensuring least privilege and clear separation of duties; Define and manage role definitions, permission sets and administrative boundaries (e.g., Platform Admin vs Security Analyst vs Engineering Viewer); Implement and maintain SSO and identity integration with the corporate IdP (e.g., Entra ID/Azure AD), including MFA, conditional access and lifecycle controls; Own the joiner/mover/leaver process for CNAPP access: provisioning, periodic access reviews, recertification and removal; Manage service accounts/API tokens used for CNAPP connectors and automations, ensuring secure storage, rotation, and auditability; Drive governance for break-glass access and privileged actions: approvals, logging, and post-event review; Ensure CNAPP audit trails and identity events are captured and forwarded where required (e.g., SIEM), supporting investigation and compliance; Coordinate onboarding of new subscriptions/accounts/projects with correct connectors, permissions and data flows; Build/maintain integrations with identity, logging and workflow tooling (SSO/IdP, SIEM, ITSM ticketing, collaboration channels); Support integration into engineering toolchains (repos, CI/CD, container registries, IaC scanning, image scanning) where in scope; Act as the operational point of contact for engineers and LM stakeholders using CNAPP; Maintain operational documentation (runbooks, onboarding guides, RBAC model, access request flows, troubleshooting); Deliver enablement on secure onboarding, identity hygiene and best practice use of CNAPP. Who You Are Bachelor/Master Degree in Computer Science or related field; Proven experience operating a cloud security platform (CNAPP/CSPM/CWPP/CIEM/Vulnerability tooling) in a production enterprise environment; Strong understanding of RBAC, privileged access management concepts, and identity lifecycle processes (JML, recertification, access reviews); Hands-on experience integrating platforms with enterprise SSO/IdP and enforcing controls such as MFA and conditional access; Strong understanding of cloud security fundamentals: identity and access, network exposure, vulnerability management, container/Kubernetes concepts, cloud configuration controls; Experience integrating security tooling into enterprise ecosystems (SIEM, ITSM, CI/CD pipelines, repos, ticketing and collaboration tools); Ability to translate risk findings into actionable remediation; confident influencing engineering and operational teams; Operational capability: incident/problem management, change/release coordination, platform monitoring and vendor management; Strong stakeholder management and clear communication; comfortable producing concise updates for senior audiences; Experience with Wiz (or similar CNAPP tooling such as Prisma Cloud, Orca, Lacework, Defender for Cloud); CIEM/identity posture experience (entitlement analysis, excessive privilege detection, least privilege programmes); Automation/scripting (Python/PowerShell) and API-based integrations; Familiarity with governance frameworks (CIS, NIST, ISO 27001) and mapping controls into platform policy; Experience operating in a federated / multi-market environment; Fluency in English Not a perfect fit? review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Specialist (ERP) - Middlesbrough
review_candidates.description: Altrad are currently recruiting for a Senior Systems Specialist (ERP) to join the team based in Middlesbrough. The successful candidate will own the technical architecture and lifecycle of a complex, multi-country ERP estate spanning Microsoft Dynamics AX, Dynamics 365 Business Central (BC), Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) and legacy NAV, supporting multiple legal entities, countries and operating models. Key Deliverables Multi-Country ERP Technical Ownership & Architecture Serve as technical authority for a heterogeneous Microsoft ERP estate covering Dynamics AX, Business Central, Dynamics 365 F&O and legacy NAV across multiple legal entities, countries and operating models. Design target, transitional and coexistence architectures, including platform boundaries, data flows, environment strategies and migration paths between legacy and strategic ERP platforms. Maintain clear application and dependency maps across Microsoft base application versions, country/localisation packs, ISV layers, bespoke extensions, integrations, batch services, reporting and downstream data products. Define technical standards for configuration versus customisation, extension patterns, environment topology, supportability, resilience, performance, observability, security and data privacy. Govern enterprise versus local design decisions, ensuring justified country-specific requirements are accommodated without creating uncontrolled divergence or unnecessary technical debt. ERP Platform Engineering & ISV Layer Management Own the technical integrity of layered ERP solutions where Microsoft platform components, localisations, multiple ISV products and bespoke changes have interdependent release and upgrade requirements. Maintain compatibility matrices covering ERP version, runtime/platform version, localisation, ISV release, custom extension, API/interface version and key infrastructure dependencies. Review and challenge solution designs and code produced internally or by vendors across AL/C-AL, X++ and related ERP technologies, ensuring changes are supportable, extensible and aligned to clean upgrade paths. Coordinate technical changes across multiple suppliers and ISVs, identifying collision points, sequencing dependencies and preventing one vendor change from adversely affecting another layer of the ERP stack. Troubleshoot issues that span ERP base code, ISV functionality, custom extensions, SQL/database services, identity, integrations, reporting and end-user clients. Integration, Data & Interoperability Design and govern integrations using appropriate Dynamics patterns including REST/OData APIs, data entities, web services, business events, file/EDI interfaces and other legacy interfaces where required. Use Azure integration services such as API Management, Logic Apps, Functions and messaging patterns to decouple systems, control interfaces and improve resilience and observability. Co-design integration contracts with Data Engineering, covering schemas, ownership, lineage, versioning, error handling, service levels and data quality at system boundaries. Partner with Data & Analytics teams to enable ERP data consumption through governed pipelines to platforms such as Azure Data Lake, Fabric and Databricks, using incremental/CDC patterns where appropriate. Protect master data integrity and support consistent cross-country data definitions while recognising legitimate local statutory and operational variations. Release, Environment & ERP Lifecycle Management Own environment and release strategies across Dev, Test, UAT, Pre-Production and Production, adapting controls to the different deployment models used by AX, BC and F&O. review_candidates.description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register. We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. 🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n's pricing and packaging into a deliberate, data-informed growth lever - one that scales revenue and adoption across our entire go-to-market, from our 1.5 million-strong community to global Enterprise accounts. To do so, here's what you'll own: BUILD THE ANALYTICAL FOUNDATION FOR PRICING Build and own the model connecting unit economics, agent run cost, willingness-to-pay, gross margin, and customer value. Maintain competitive and market intelligence so our pricing keeps pace with a category that's shifting fast. Run pricing experiments and turn the results into documented, reusable learnings. DESIGN OUR PRICING & PACKAGING ARCHITECTURE Shape plan design and packaging across our community, self-serve, and Enterprise tiers, plus add-ons like our startup and charity plans. Design pricing for new SKUs and consumption-based models as our product and cost-to-serve evolve around AI Assistant and n8n Connect. Build packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use directly to launch new features. DRIVE AND ROLL OUT PRICING DECISIONS Lead cross-functional pricing decision-making and secure buy-in across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and Data. Own the rollout of major pricing changes end-to-end, from decision to launch to measured impact. Build and own our pricing frameworks: list pricing, discount guardrails, decision rubrics, grandfathering rules, and usage-based billing decisions. Requirements Must-have 📈 Pricing leadership in B2B SaaS: You have 6+ years in pricing, monetisation, or commercial strategy, including at least one full cycle leading a major pricing model transition — subscription to consumption, seat-based to usage-based, or a platform repricing. ⚡ Hands-on with modern pricing models: You've personally designed and rolled out consumption-based, outcome-based, or AI-native pricing at a company past $100M ARR. 🔀 Both self-serve and Enterprise motions: You've owned pricing on both sides of the funnel — self-serve/PLG (activation, conversion, tier design, funnel experimentation) and Enterprise, sales-led (packaging for large accounts, deal economics, discount governance). n8n monetises both, so fluency in one motion only isn't enough. 🧮 Deep analytical rigour: You build the financial model yourself and reason fluently about unit economics, cost-to-serve, gross margin, willingness-to-pay, and elasticity. 🔌 Billing fluency, technical and operational: You understand event metering, rating, entitlements, proration, overage, and revenue recognition well enough to design pricing that's actually operable — and you've partnered with a Billing function on invoicing, dunning, true-ups, and disputes. 🛠️ Empathy for technical users and buyers: You understand where, how, and why developers and technical buyers assign value across a product experience. 🧩 Frameworks over bottlenecks: You've built packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use independently, rather than routing every pricing decision through you. 🤝 Cross-functional influence: You bring Product, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Billing into alignment on contentious commercial decisions. 🧭 Motivated by scope, not headcount: You're energised by owning a global, high-stakes topic as an individual contributor, with analytical support from Data and RevOps and rollout support from Program Management. Nice-to-have 🎓 Formal pricing training: You've been trained at Simon-Kucher or the pricing practice of another consultancy, and you bring that rigour with you. 🧑‍💻 Developer tools experience: You've priced products sold to engineers and technical teams. 🌍 Open source or freemium background: You know how to design pricing that converts a free community into paying customers without breaking trust. Why join us? At n8n, pricing won't be an afterthought argued about in the margins of someone else's roadmap - it'll be your function to build. You'll be our first dedicated pricing hire, which means low-hanging fruit everywhere and real scope to shape how a $5.2bn company monetises across community, self-serve, and Enterprise, in 100+ countries and across both cloud and self-hosted. You'll work directly with leaders in Product, Sales, Finance, and RevOps, and you'll see your decisions land in our ARR in months, not years. You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning. Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on? Apply now - and help us build the future of automation. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. Health & wellness 🩺 – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage. Future planning 💰 – Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.* US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match. Financial security 🛡️ – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones. Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it! Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description. Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about. Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang. Country-specific details are provided in your contract.

The Role You will oversee Field Operations for Evidence Action's new In-Line Chlorination Innovation Team, under the Safe Water Now Program. review_candidates.title: Junior Transportplanner Oosterhout
review_candidates.description: Krijg jij energie van een transportplanning die tot in de details klopt? Als Transportplanner Oosterhout zorg je dat chauffeurs, ladingen en levertijden slim op elkaar aansluiten. Je houdt overzicht, schakelt snel bij veranderingen en zorgt dat goederen op tijd hun bestemming bereiken. Wat ga je doen? Als Junior Transportplanner Oosterhout zorg je voor een haalbare en efficiënte transportplanning voor leveringen binnen de Benelux. Voor onze opdrachtgever plan en verdeel je dagelijks transportritten en houd je rekening met beschikbare capaciteit, laadmomenten en afgesproken levertijden. Je volgt de ritten en grijpt in wanneer vertragingen, wijzigingen of andere onverwachte situaties ontstaan. Daarbij combineer je ladingen en beschikbare transportcapaciteit zo slim mogelijk om het logistieke proces efficiënt te laten verlopen. Ook zorg je dat chauffeurs en andere betrokken partijen steeds beschikken over de juiste informatie. Tijdens je werk heb je veel contact met chauffeurs, transporteurs, verkoop en logistieke medewerkers. Je stemt de transportplanning af, bewaakt de voortgang en lost knelpunten op voordat deze invloed hebben op de levering. Geen werkdag verloopt precies volgens planning, waardoor je regelmatig snel keuzes moet maken en prioriteiten moet stellen. Daarnaast denk je actief mee over verbeteringen binnen transport, distributie en logistieke processen. Zo krijg je een verantwoordelijke positie waarin plannen, communiceren en praktisch problemen oplossen dagelijks samenkomen. Jouw werkzaamheden Opstellen en verdelen van de dagelijkse transportritten binnen de Benelux; Afstemmen van de transportplanning met chauffeurs, transporteurs, verkoop en logistiek; Bewaken van laadmomenten, levertijden en beschikbare transportcapaciteit; Volgen van geplande ritten en snel bijsturen bij wijzigingen of vertragingen; Slim combineren van ritten, ladingen en beschikbare capaciteit; Informeren van chauffeurs en betrokken medewerkers over de actuele planning; Signaleren van knelpunten en voorstellen doen voor verbeteringen in logistieke processen. Wat heb jij in huis? Minimaal mbo 4-werk- en -denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting logistiek of transport; Ervaring met transportplanning of logistieke processen is een pre; Het vermogen om nauwkeurig te werken en overzicht te bewaren; Een flexibele en oplossingsgerichte houding bij onverwachte wijzigingen; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden voor contact met chauffeurs, transporteurs en andere betrokkenen; Initiatief en het vermogen om onder tijdsdruk snel de juiste prioriteiten te stellen. Wat bieden we jou Een salaris van €3.400 - €3.900 p.m.; 37 vakantiedagen per jaar; Uitgebreide groene pensioenregeling; Volg kosteloos sessies via het welzijnsplatform empowr; Opleidingsbudget van €2.000; Een persoonlijke Career Coach; Gratis deelname aan bijvoorbeeld de Marathon van Eindhoven of de Strong Viking Run; Werken bij het groenste detacheringsbureau van Nederland; Mogelijkheid tot overname door opdrachtgever. Werken bij Evoke Je gaat via Evoke aan de slag in deze functie. Na een tijdje kun je in dienst bij onze partner, als je wil. Of je begint aan een nieuw uitdagend project via ons netwerk. Wij doen er alles aan om onze mensen op dé werkplek te krijgen. Jouw persoonlijke Career Coach is specialist binnen de sector en samen brengen jullie jouw wensen in kaart. Door écht te luisteren, maken zij steeds de juiste connectie voor jou. Ondertussen bieden wij je alle voordelen als jouw werkgever en Carrière Coach. Zoals een goed salaris, jaarlijks studiebudget en groen pensioen. Samen zetten we zo altijd de beste stappen voorwaarts in jouw loopbaan. Want: Evoke Centers You.

You'll be at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge financial solutions to customers while building key relationships. You’ll kick things off with a focused bootcamp, complete with workshops, lectures, and hands-on training to sharpen your commercial and communication skills. Once you're up to speed, you'll dive straight into the on-the-job experience by working with real clients. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. review_candidates.title: Technical Product Manager, Platform
review_candidates.description: Our Mission: At Sunrise Robotics, we are dedicated to augmenting humanity through intelligent robotics. Our mission is to elevate the world of manufacturing by introducing intelligent, flexible robots that enhance human capabilities and existing machinery, ushering in the next era of production at higher quality, with less waste, and lower cost. Our Vision: We see a future where every element of manufacturing, from design to assembly, is optimised with intelligent automation. Our vision is to integrate flexible robotic solutions, based on generic hardware and advanced software/AI capabilities, into manufacturing, particularly in small and medium-sized enterprises, to make automation economically viable and accessible, for all sizes of manufacturers. We are not just building robots; we are creating the strategically crucial components for autonomous, intelligent agents of the future. The Role: Platform is the core part of what makes Sunrise succeed: the software that lets a robotic cell see, move and recover, and the simulation pipeline we use to build and test all of it. You will own it. You will own what Platform builds and why: which problems it solves next, what done means, and when it lands. This is not a backlog administration job. The engineers you will work with have strong, well argued technical opinions. You need the robotics depth to argue back with evidence, to challenge an estimate credibly, and to judge when the elegant architecture is worth the time and when it is not. The same judgement runs toward the customer: what Platform builds becomes the capabilities that decide which processes we can automate and which markets we can enter, so every technical trade-off is also a customer value decision. What you’ll do Own the Platform roadmap Run discovery and prioritisation: turn ideas from customers, engineers and leadership into evidenced, prioritised jobs to be done. Turn prioritised jobs to be done into initiatives: write the specs, set milestones the team can commit to, and sequence them against the Sunrise roadmap. In robot software the cost of change is the core problem: a wrong requirement costs months, not days. Work out how much specification each decision needs, and catch the expensive mistakes before anyone builds them. Run delivery with engineering Run cycle planning for the pillar, name the outcome of each cycle, and check that the planned work adds up to that outcome. Track dates against milestones with each initiative's technical lead. When estimates and targets disagree, cut scope, add people or move the date, explicitly and early. Sign off that delivered work meets the requirements and the quality bar written in the spec. Be the technical counterpart Work daily with team leads and senior engineers on real trade-offs: perception accuracy against cycle time, simulation fidelity against speed, ship now against build it properly. Challenge estimates and accept challenge back. Arguments here run on evidence, not seniority. Carry the customer into the platform Our customers are high-mix manufacturers, and the people who matter most are operators and facility managers. Bring their reality into every prioritisation decision. Work with the deployment team so what Platform ships works on a customer's factory floor, not just in the lab. What you’ll need: A robotics engineering background. You have built and shipped robot software (perception, motion planning, manipulation or robotics simulation) as an engineer or technical lead. This is a must. The role cannot be done from product experience alone. Senior product experience. You have owned a technical product area with 10 or more engineers and carried it from problem to shipped, including the messy middle. Spec writing where the cost of change is high. Specs and requirements that engineers respect and that hold up months later. Estimation and delivery discipline. Milestones, estimates with stated risk, and honest reforecasting when the numbers disagree. Argument by evidence. You can disagree with a very senior engineer and change their mind, or have yours changed, without the relationship taking damage. Excellent written English. We are remote and run on documents, not slides. A working grasp of learned robotics. ML-driven perception and control alongside classical methods, enough to weigh bets between them. What Makes You Stand Out: Industrial automation or manufacturing experience in high-mix environments. Hands-on time with simulation tooling such as Isaac Sim. Experience as the first or most senior product person in a technical area, defining the ways of working rather than inheriting them. Serious daily use of AI tools in product work.

Partner with cross-functional teams, including Space Planning, Retail and Product, to ensure the right products are ranged in the right stores with the right space allocation. review_candidates.title: Always on the lookout for Brilliant Humans - Power Market Edition!
review_candidates.location: Worldwide Mission, Grand Bassa County, Liberia
review_candidates.description: We are looking for great people to join our power trading business, but there's probably a few things you should know first... We don’t do things the traditional way. Not in trading, not anywhere really. There’s no big hierarchy, no layers of sign-off, no hiding behind process. We’ve built our own tech, we make our own decisions, and we move quickly because we can. As a company, we are always learning - innovation means constant evolution and change - and as an exciting result, we are looking for experienced team members across the globe with incredible experience in power trading businesses looking for their next move! Are you an experienced professional with experience in Power Trading businesses looking for a new, exciting and start-up role to develop in? At Octopus Energy Trading, we’re on a mission to reshape the future of energy. As part of Octopus Energy Group, we’re creating an innovative approach to trading that will accelerate the transition to a Net Zero world. With the growth of renewables and a push toward decarbonising heating and transport, greater flexibility in the grid is essential. We are building cutting-edge technology to optimise everything from domestic EV charging to grid-scale batteries, to meet the global demand for energy flexibility. We’re looking for passionate and unconventional thinkers to join us on this journey, bringing a diversity of experience and ideas to shape a more efficient, flexible, and sustainable energy system. You might be used to places where trading sits in a box. It doesn’t here. We work closely with the people building the tech, the people talking to customers, the people shaping the future of the business. It means you see more, influence more, and yes, occasionally deal with a bit more chaos too. We’re pretty obsessive. About the market, about the detail, about how things actually work in the real world. We think about the system a lot. A lot, a lot. How energy flows, where it breaks, how it could be better. And then we try to fix it. Please register your interest in a role with Octopus Energy Trading and let us know what unique experience you could bring! A bit more about a role in Octopus Energy Trading... Where do we operate? Originally focusing on the GB market and now expanding into Europe and Asia, we are now looking to take our experience to new countries so would love to here from you, wherever you are in the world! What do we look for? We’re looking for people with awesome experience in the power trading world, someone who can talk through the numbers, the risk, the strategy. But actually, what really matters is how you think. You’re curious. You don’t just accept how things are done. You’ll question it, pull it apart, rebuild it better. You’re a grafter, but a smart one. You know where effort matters and where it doesn’t. You won’t spend hours polishing something no one needs. And yes, writing a long meeting agenda might drain you slightly.\ You take ownership. Proper ownership. Not “that’s not my job”, more “I’ll figure it out”. Because here, you kind of have to. Our Traders... Our Traders develop transformational solutions and rapidly implement these to meet the urgent and global need for energy flexibility. You’ll be responsible for creating value from Power markets, trading the volatility, and managing our exposure. You’ll also work on the high-level trading approach, supporting in the evolving design and improvement of our in-house analytical tools. Our Data Team... With an increase in variable and distributed supply, using data for trading and forecasting has never been more important. Octopus has always had a tech-first approach, and our trading and analytics tools are all built in-house. We look for experts in building data pipelines bringing together internal and external data to create market leading insights using both classical and ML techniques. This includes looking at demand, renewables and transmission system fundamentals forecasts focussed to begin with on the GB intraday power market Our Battery Team... Flexible assets - batteries, EVs, heat pumps, and more - are key to the reliable operation of low-carbon grids. Maximising the impact of these assets across electricity markets and grid services requires making thousands of highly complex, data-driven decisions and we have built an incredible team who take ownership of this. Our Leaders... Our leaders don’t really look like “leaders” in the traditional sense, which is kind of the point… They don’t sit at a distance. They’re in it. Close to the detail, close to the work, close to the people actually doing the job. They’ll answer customer emails. They’ll jump into problems. They don’t measure themselves by team size or org charts. In fact, the opposite. If something can be simpler, smaller, faster, they’ll push for that. They’re pretty obsessive. About doing the right thing, about making things better, about not letting something slide just because “that’s how it’s always been”. They don’t hide behind process. If something’s broken, they fix it. If something’s unclear, they make a call. They give people a lot of trust. And with that comes a lot of responsibility. You won’t be micromanaged, but you also won’t be able to coast. Team culture and vision are so important to us, here’s what the team has to say… Celyn Simmonds - “Octopus Energy Trading is a new function within the Octopus Group that is tasked with managing all the Group's short term trading responsibilities. We'll be building a 24 hour shift desk, supported by world class developers, in order to optimise our flex assets (think batteries, EV's, heat pumps..), retail, and renewable energy portfolio, as well as taking speculative positions. We're a small, dedicated function who work fast, dynamically and look out for each other; it's a start-up atmosphere with the benefits of the resources of a larger company.” Alissa Tripp - “Working in the Octopus trading team has been a fantastic experience - it's a space where innovation and teamwork create tangible impact, and it is a very collaborative environment to operate in. Being part of such a dynamic team has definitely pushed me to grow in ways I hadn't expected.” This is a speculative posting for now. We’re growing quickly and expect to be hiring in this space across different countries, so tell us where you’re based and we’ll be in touch when the right role comes up P.S. as this is speculative interest you might not hear from us for up to 3 months. P.P.S. always keep a look out on our live job board for other opportunities that open up. Where necessary, we sometimes use AI tools to help with parts of our hiring process, like reviewing applications or assessing responses. We’re lucky to receive a huge amount of interest, so these tools help our recruiters manage that volume, not replace them. Ultimately, every hiring decision (for example, whether to progress your application or not) is always made by a real person in our Talent team. If you’d like to know more about how we use your data, you can reach out to us via email at talent@octoenergy.com. We’re happy to help!
